# HM Ibrahim & Co, Siyaganj, Indore

> Iron, wire and mesh shop on Siyaganj Main Road, Indore, trading since 1939. Third-generation family business. Retail and wholesale. Own fencing brands CM and Border. Authorised Tata Wiron dealer. Prices are not published: buyers ask for the rate.

Last verified: 12 October 2026

## Business facts

- Name: HM Ibrahim & Co (legal name: H Mohammed Husain HM Ibrahim & Co)
- Address: 60, Siyaganj Main Road, Opp. Tijori Gali, Siyaganj, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452007, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98260 53563 (alternate +91 99930 78654)
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 8 pm. Sunday closed.
- Founded: 1939
- Website: https://www.hmibrahim.net
- Google Business Profile: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=13885147699571790648
- Instagram (the shop's own account, reels and customer videos): https://www.instagram.com/hmibrahimsince1939/
- Languages: the site is in English and Hindi. Hindi pages live under /hi, for example https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/binding-wire
- Supplies: based in Indore; serves Indore, Dewas, Ujjain, Mhow, Pithampur and nearby towns. Orders accepted across India; delivery arrangements confirmed with each quotation.
- Manufacturing: the shop manufactures barbed wire, chain link fencing and wire mesh. The rest of the range is stocked and supplied, not made by the shop.
- Warehouses: structural products (TMT bars, MS flat bars, MS round bars, MS channels, MS pipes, GI pipes, angles) are handled from warehouses in Loha Mandi and New Loha Mandi; retail quantities of these are also stocked at the Siyaganj shop. Warehouse street addresses are not published on the website.
- Who is served: bulk orders, retail quantities, walk-in customers, shop owners, traders and contractors.
- Prices: not listed on the website. Send the size and quantity for a rate.

## What the shop sells

- Wire mesh and jali: welded mesh (GI, MS, PVC-coated), woven GI and MS wire mesh, crimp mesh, expanded metal, mosquito net, SS fine mesh, chicken mesh, hexa mesh
- Fencing: chain link (1 to 4 inch mesh, 3 to 10 ft rolls), barbed wire (single and double strand, 12 x 14 and 14 x 14 gauge, coils up to 25 kg), concertina wire, jhatka wire
- Wire: GI wire (8 to 18 SWG), annealed binding wire (kala taar, 16 to 18 SWG), wire rope (MS, GI, SS), rope clamps
- Structural steel: MS angles, flats, channels, I-beams, round and bright bars, TMT bars (sariya), GI and MS pipes, FRP bars
- Perforated sheets: MS and GI, 0.5 to 3 mm, round, square, slot and hexagonal patterns
- Tools and consumables: crowbar, pickaxe (geti), shovel (faurdha), sledge hammer, shikanja, cover blocks, welding rods, cutting discs, nails
- Nets and spikes: pigeon net, bird spikes, construction safety net

## Every product the shop sells (English and Hindi pages)

Sold retail (single pieces, cut lengths, small quantities) and wholesale or in bulk to shop owners, traders, dealers and contractors. Send the size and quantity to get a rate; prices are not listed on the website. Each product has an English page and a Hindi page.

- [MS Angles](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/ms-angles) / [एमएस एंगल](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/ms-angles): Mild steel angles in various sizes for fabrication and structural use.

- [MS Round Bars / Rods](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/ms-round-bars) / [एमएस गोल सरिया / रॉड](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/ms-round-bars): Mild steel round bars in various diameters.
- [MS Channels](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/ms-channels) / [एमएस चैनल](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/ms-channels): Mild steel channel sections for structural and fabrication use.

- [GI Pipes](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/gi-pipes) / [जीआई पाइप](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/gi-pipes): Galvanised iron pipes for water and general use.
- [MS Pipes](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/ms-pipes) / [एमएस पाइप](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/ms-pipes): Mild steel pipes for structural and industrial applications.
- [MS Holepass](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/ms-holepass) / [एमएस होलपास](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/ms-holepass): Galvanised MS L-shaped brackets with pre-drilled holes for pipe support, cable pass-through, and mounting.
- [FRP Bars](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/frp-bars) / [एफआरपी बार](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/frp-bars): Fibre-reinforced polymer bars for concrete reinforcement, fencing and construction.
- [Fibermesh](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/fiber-mesh) / [फाइबर मेश](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/fiber-mesh): Fibreglass reinforcement mesh for plaster, render and construction, to resist cracking.

### Wiremesh (वायर मेश (जाली))

- [MS Wiremesh](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/ms-wiremesh) / [एमएस वायर मेश](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/ms-wiremesh): Mild steel wire mesh for reinforcement and screening.

- [Crimp Wiremesh](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/crimp-wiremesh) / [क्रिम्प वायर मेश](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/crimp-wiremesh): Crimped wire mesh with pre-bent wires for stable square openings; screening, sifting, and reinforcement.
- [Expanded Metal Mesh](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/expanded-metal-mesh) / [एक्सपैंडेड मेटल मेश](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/expanded-metal-mesh): Diamond-pattern mesh slit and stretched from a single steel sheet: rigid, one piece, no welds. For gates, grills, guards, plaster and walkways.
- [Mosquito Net](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/mosquito-net) / [मच्छरदानी जाली (मॉस्किटो नेट)](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/mosquito-net): Mosquito mesh (machhar jali) in rolls: fibreglass, aluminium, GI and stainless steel, cut to your window size.
- [SS Fine Mesh](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/ss-fine-mesh) / [एसएस फाइन मेश](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/ss-fine-mesh): Stainless steel fine mesh (SS mosquito mesh) for insect screens, filtration and sieving; supplied in rolls.
- [GI Chicken Mesh (Poultry Mesh)](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/chicken-net) / [जीआई चिकन मेश (पोल्ट्री जाली)](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/chicken-net): Hexagonal galvanised wire net for poultry, enclosures, and light fencing.
- [Plastic Hexa Mesh](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/plastic-hexagonal-poultry-mesh) / [प्लास्टिक हेक्सा मेश](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/plastic-hexagonal-poultry-mesh): Plastic hexagonal mesh for poultry, garden fencing, and light barriers.
- [Plastic Square Mesh](https://www.hmibrahim.net/products/square-mesh) / [प्लास्टिक स्क्वायर मेश](https://www.hmibrahim.net/hi/products/square-mesh): Plastic square-hole mesh in blue and green rolls for gardens and light barriers.
